name: yunalesca
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one standalone Kalistar illustration, never a card or contact sheet. Deliver a true 4:5 portrait, ideally 1024 x 1280, edge-to-edge painting. Image 1 Momo is the primary STYLE reference: visible rich brushwork, large painted color planes, narrative emotion, worn material, controlled edges. Image 2 Valazar is secondary STYLE reference for volumes and textured materials, NOT an instruction to make every scene gloomy. Image 3 is IDENTITY reference only: preserve recognizable FF10 face/hair/costume cues but DO NOT copy its portrait pose, smooth rendering, white background or anime stylization. Render the face with the SAME textured, mature painterly treatment as the Kalistar references, natural eye scale, no anime or photographic skin.
Composition: a 737 x 921 card-art window will contain this image. Keep face and main hands within central x20-78%; all essential equipment within x18-80%. Show full body or generous three-quarter figure with margin above head, enough breathing room below action and lateral margins. Character is large and legible, not tiny. Main contrast on face and story gesture. Restrained evocative background with broad values, no dense crowd. Coherent anatomy: one head, exactly two arms and two legs; coherent hands, contacts and continuous equipment.
No text, numbers, lettering, logos, watermark, card frame, barcode, interface, photo, polished 3D, manga, artificial glamor pose, extra limbs, uniform digital noise. This is an original scene interpretation, not a copied game screenshot.
Subject and scene: Lady Yunalesca, clearly ADULT ancient summoner from FINAL FANTASY X, human first form, standing in the ruined sanctuary of Zanarkand before the last summoning. Preserve the identity reference's recognizable exceptionally long straight silver-white hair, geometric blue-green head ornaments rising slenderly above the hair, stern beautiful face, blue-gold ceremonial jewelry and turquoise-green hanging side ribbons. A tasteful fully covered interpretation of her canonical ceremonial costume: ornate dark blue patterned fitted bodice and a long flowing turquoise silk sarong draped at waist over the hips and legs, jewelry and long drapery echo the original costume. No nudity, no erotic framing or focus. She extends ONE empty open hand slightly forward at chest height as though calmly explaining an unbearable sacrifice; the other relaxed by her side. Her expression has calm, terrifying certainty, compassionate surface with unyielding eyes; no screaming, monster form, snakes or gore. IMPORTANT user request: NO crystal ball, NO orb, NO held sphere, NO spherical magic effect, NO staff or weapon anywhere. Both hands visibly empty. Portrait from head to feet or generous long three-quarter, tall centered silhouette. Broken high stone arches and old low steps fade into dim cool haze, a restrained worn mosaic at her feet; no elaborate clutter or other people. Her long white hair and drapery flow gently, never confused with extra arms. Cool daylight through a broken vault and a faint warm reflected edge from old stone reveal tactile fabric and painterly facial planes. Haunting dignified narrative painting in exact Kalistar family, not a fashion photo or clean anime illustration.
